from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(out[0])
    solid_rows = [row for row in out if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    if not solid_rows:
        return out
    color = solid_rows[0][0]
    partial = [i for i, row in enumerate(out) if sum(v == color for v in row) not in (0, width)]
    if not partial:
        return out
    # Extend the partial horizontal bar with color 1 to the right edge.
    i = partial[-1]
    end = max(j for j, v in enumerate(out[i]) if v == color)
    for j in range(end + 1, width):
        out[i][j] = 1
    return out
'''

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(out[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    solid_rows = [row for row in out if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    if not solid_rows:
        return out
    color = solid_rows[0][0]
    partial = [i for i, row in enumerate(out) if any(v == color for v in row) and any(v != color for v in row)]
    if not partial:
        return out
    i = partial[-1]
    end = max(j for j, v in enumerate(out[i]) if v == color)
    for j in range(end + 1, width):
        out[i][j] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(code,ns)
print(ns['transform'](test)[12])
